sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 720. Deals physical damage 2 times that penetrates any nullifying or invulnerability effects with a success value of 100. (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Constriction. The next Ability used will change from targeting all to a single target (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 80% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies debuff removal resistance that blocks debuff removal, special debuff removal, or kismet 1 time.
-Target: all enemies (NPCs). Decreases action speed by 60 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 120 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
-Applies Burial Eclipse (decreases all stats by 40%, decreases physical and magic Ability Power by 100, and increases Ability Power of damage taken by 50) to the enemy field for 90 seconds.
Lowers the effect of Unison gauge reduction by 50% when equipped in the main slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Serenity for 120 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
Confuse and Despair Resistance Up by 60
Water and Dark Defense from Unison Damage +600
